column1: # One row per (distro, arch, env, mode) scenario. The qualification harness
# reads this file; every field except `result`/`evidence` is authored intent.
#   mode          inplace|disk|reject   (reject = must refuse safely, negative test)
# result/evidence are appended by the harness (qualify.sh) at run time:
#   - A PASS in mode=reject means the installer refused safely (negative test).
#     It NEVER counts as a supported-distribution conversion.
#   - Only mode=inplace PASS with a successful `ez-info` probe counts as a
# ---- Debian family: in-place conversion is the advertised contract ---------
# ^ mint has no official plain-docker image with systemd; refuse-untested is NA.
#   Kept out of the executable set until a pinned image exists (see report).
# ---- Non-Debian families: contract is SAFE REJECTION, never conversion ------
# EZpenguin is a Debian replacement userland; extracting it over rpm/dnf/yum
# or musl/apk systems would destroy their package databases. The installer
# must detect these and refuse BEFORE any destructive change. These are
# negative tests — PASS = safe refusal, not support.
# ---- VM paths (QEMU guests, inside Docker-managed lab) ---------------------
# Non-Debian VMs: same rejection contract applies before any disk damage
